title: SimWorld seed roads file (roads.json)
description: Author-drawn inter-city roads (docs/spec-world-seed.md sections 4.5, 5.4). Each road passes through every author point.

format.description: File format version. This library reads 1.

id.description: Stable id, unique in the file; seeds the road's cosmetic noise.

class.description: Road class (profile road classes: width, lamps, LOD drop).

lit.description: Share 0..1 of the length with street lamps (default 0).

from.description: City id or airport:<ident> the road starts at; null = ends where its points end.

to.description: City id or airport:<ident> the road ends at; null = ends where its points end.
